content: Judah santoung nahane kamnuesaknae
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
Tami capa, nang teh tarankathaw e imthung koe doeh na o. Hmunae mit a tawn eiteh, hmawt thai hoeh, thainae hnâ a tawn eiteh, ka thaipanuek hoeh e naw tarankathaw e imthung lah na o awh.

Hatdawkvah, nang tami capa santoungnae koe ka cet hane patetlah na hnopai kahawicalah taoung nateh, khodai lah ahnimae hmaitung roeroe vah kamthaw haw. Na hmu awh lahun nah na onae hmuen koehoi hmuen alouke koe na cei han. Tarankathaw e lah kaawm awh nakunghai a lung a ang awh yawkaw han doeh.
Na hnopainaw hah khodai lah ahnimae hmaitung roeroe vah, santoungnae koe ka cet hane ni hno lae patetlah na la han. Nang nama roeroe hai ahnimae hmaitung vah ram louk ka cet hane patetlah na cei han.
Ahnimae hmaitung vah kalupnae rapan hah na raphoe vaiteh, hawvah na hno hah na tâcokhai han.

Ahnimae hmaitung roeroe vah na loung hoi na hrawm vaiteh, khohmo na tâcokhai han. Talai na hmu hoeh na han na minhmai na ramuk han. Bangkongtetpawiteh, Isarel imthung hanelah a khetsin hanelah na ta toe telah a ti.
Kâ na poe e patetlah ka sak teh ka hnopai hah santoung hane patetlah kanîthun vah ka tâcokhai, Ka kut hoi karum rapan ka raphoe teh, karum lah ahnimae hmaitung roeroe vah ka loung dawk ka hrawm.
Hahoi amom vah Bawipa Jehovah e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
tami capa Isarel imthung, tarankathaw e imthung ni nang koevah, bang ne na sak telah ati nahoehmaw.
Ahnimouh koe Jehovah Cathut ni hettelah a dei, hete lawk heh Jerusalem kacuenaw hoi ahnimouh koe kaawm e Isarel imthung abuemlae kong doeh.
Nangmouh hanelah khetsin hanelah ahmaloe kamnue sak e doeh. Ka sak e boiboe lah ahnimae lathueng hai ka sak han. San lah toung sak hanelah man lah ao han telah tet pouh.

Ahnimouh koe kaawm rae kahrawikungnaw ni khohmo thung a hnopai a loung hoi a hrawm awh vaiteh, a tâco awh han. A tâco awh nahane rapannaw a raphoe awh han. A mit hoi ram a hmu awh hoeh nahanelah, a minhmai a ramuk awh han.
Ahni teh kaie tamlawk hoi ka ramuk vaiteh, kaie masi dawk a kâman han. Khaldean ram e Babilon vah ka thokhai han. Haw tueng vah kadout nakunghai khopui hmawt mahoeh.
Ahni kabawm hanelah a teng kaawm e hoi kâkaheisak vaiteh, rayu tangcoung e tahloi hoi ka pâlei han.
Miphunnaw koe ka kâkaheisak teh ram tangkuem koe ka pâlei navah, BAWIPA lah ka o e hah a panue awh han.

Hateiteh, tahloi hoi takang patawnae naw thung hoi tami youn touh ka cawi sak han. Ahnimouh ni a tho awh hoeh nae ram koelae miphunnaw koevah, panuettho e pueng hah a kamnue sak awh nahan, kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o e hah a panue awh han telah a ti.
Lawkcengnae tahruet hoeh
Hothloilah BAWIPA e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
tami capa pâyaw laihoi rawca cat nateh, kâhruetcuet laihoi tui hah net haw.

Hote ram dawk e taminaw koe Bawipa Jehovah ni Jerusalem e kho ka sak e thoseh, Isarel ram e kho ka sak e koe thoseh, hettelah a dei. Ahnimouh ni kâhruetcuet laihoi rawca a ca awh han. Lungpuen laihoi tui a nei awh han, hottelahoi khocanaw ni a sak awh e kathout hno thung kaawm e hnonaw thung hoi a hlout awh han.
Tami a onae khonaw a rawk teh ram pueng kingkadi lah ao han, kai teh BAWIPA lah ka o tie a panue awh han telah a ti.
Hahoi BAWIPA e lawk kai koe a pha teh,
Tami capa, a hnintha a loum toteh kamnuek e vision hai a rawk toe telah ouk na ti awh e hah Isarel ram dawk ouk hno e cingthuilawk hah bangtelane.

Hatdawkvah, Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Hete cingthuilawk kaduemca e heh ka pahnawt teh Isarel ram dawk hno awh mahoeh toe. A hnintha a hnai toe. Kamnuek e vision pueng akuep nahane tueng a hnai toe telah ahnimouh koe a dei pouh.
Isarel imthungnaw thung dawk aphu kaawm hoeh e kamnuek e hoi hawinae koe lah cungpam rayunae roeroe awm mahoeh toe.

Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA lah ka o. Ka dei e hah kuepsak lah ao han, akuepnae tueng hai tahruet mahoeh. Tarankathaw e imthungnaw na hring nathung roeroe lawk ka dei vaiteh ka kuep sak mingming hah telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei telah a ti.
BAWIPA e lawk kai koe bout a pha teh,
tami capa thai haw, Isarel imthung ni kamnuenae a hmu e teh hmalah hanelah doeh, a dei tangcoung e hai hmalah hane doeh telah atipouh.
Hatdawkvah, ahnimouh koe Bawipa Jehovah ni hettelah a dei. Ka lawk ceitakhai e awm mahoeh. Ka dei e lawk pueng heh kuep sak e lah ao han, telah Bawipa Jehovah ni a dei telah dei pouh telah a ti.
